# P1.09 — Approvals, full surface: all twelve kinds, structured editing, presence UX, policy + guidance settings

Spec: `docs/tickets/37_P1.09__approvals-full.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.09.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (deploy `api` + `web` to `dev`,
migration `0032`, bounded live verify, $0) is operator-gated → **D-P1.09-1**. The first live
Approve-plan exercise rides P1.10's instrumented Draft run; the standalone `/app/inbox` page is
P1.19's.

## Summary

The §6.4 approve-with-deadline card is now the full surface: **every one of the twelve `GateKind`s**
renders the same anatomy — artifact under decision, deadline (relative + absolute) or "waiting for
you", the do-nothing sentence, cost so far + remaining estimate, and the five actions (Approve
pre-filled · Approve and run autonomously · Edit guidance / Keep planning · Wait for me · Stop) —
**identically** in the Timeline run card and the Needs-you/Inbox row (a `<details>` whose sheet
mounts the same `GateCard` element — read-before-approve, SSR/no-JS). Kind-specific structured
fields are editable (plan spine reorder/strike/add+note, section order/words/function, cut-list
protect/restore toggles, scope stage/venue/audience/concerns/narrowing, thesis pick) and serialize
through the existing `resolveGate` → `serializeGateOverlay` path into overlay versions +
`Guidance{source:'gate_edit'}` rows with the change count on the decision line. The presence-timer
UX emits its countdown/ping markup only on auto-proceed kinds with an activity URL; the
never-auto-proceed invariant is enforced at the view-model layer, not trusted to callers. Project
settings gains the Approvals section (the three verbatim policy values + per-kind deadline
overrides validating REQ-SPEC-1 verbatim), standing-guidance management (add / list active+retired /
retire / retire-and-replace edit), per-run `gate_overrides` + the `gates_off` "this run only,
autonomously" launch flag, permanent decision lines on run cards, and the once-per-user inline
explainer.

## What landed

**`@rhema/contracts`** — `guidance.ts` gains the `gate_edit` source kind so every structured edit
lands as a first-class Guidance record (REQ-SPEC-9: the user edits decisions, never prose).

**`@rhema/findings-core`** — `gate-card.ts`: `GateCardWire` (the full card DTO incl. `artifactId`,
`modelTier`, `structured`), `GateStructuredView` slots (`plan`/`scope`/`cutList`/`facts`/`thesis`),
`GateDecisionView` (the permanent line — actor, at, change count, `by`/`presence`), `needsYouOrder()`
(blocked-on-you first by soonest deadline → waiting → informational), and the
`NEVER_AUTOPROCEED_GATES` enforcement inside `buildGateCard` itself. `gate-edits.ts` (new): the
`ed.*` form-field decoder + deterministic sidecar apply (one-based `ord` destination semantics;
section rows tagged by original index so multi-move submissions don't drift). `run-card.ts` /
`timeline.ts`: `decisions` + `gate` wire slots.

**`@rhema/ui`** — `gate-card.tsx` gains the per-kind structured editors (PlanEditor, ScopeEditor,
CutListToggles, thesis pick, generic fact lines), the `explainer` slot + dismiss form, and the
decision lines under the card; `approval-row.tsx` (new) is the §5.11 `<details>` row — kind label,
artifact, deadline/"waiting for you", do-nothing, spend — expanding to the artifact link + the
same `GateCard`. `run-card.tsx` renders permanent decision lines (optional prop — back-compat with
older fixtures); `timeline.tsx` mounts the full card under a waiting run; `run-sheet.tsx` exposes
the Approvals pick + `autoProceedRun`; `ide-shell.tsx` carries the `renderGateCard` slot.

**`apps/api`** — `approval-routes.ts` (new): `GET/PUT /projects/:id/settings/approvals` (policy +
overrides through `approvalOverridesSchema` — 422 on spend kinds, shorten, <2h add),
`PUT /projects/:id/runs/:rid/gate-overrides` (per-run layer + `gates_off`),
`POST /projects/:id/guidance` + `/guidance/:gid/retire`, `GET /settings/explainers` +
`POST /settings/explainers/:name/dismiss`. `gate-dto.ts` (new): the shared gate-DTO loader
(structured bodies from sidecar parses — plan/cut-list/scope/facts incl. `choose_thesis`) consumed
by both `triage-routes.ts` (Needs-you) and `timeline-routes.ts` (run cards) so both mounts serialize
the identical wire. `run-routes.ts`: `autoProceedRun` freezes `runs.gates_off` at create.

**`packages/orchestrator` + `apps/run-task`** — `gate-policy.ts` gains `loadGatePolicyFacts` +
`gatePolicyContextFromFacts` (the layered project → per-run resolution, `gates_off` included);
`HarnessRunSpec.gatePolicy` carries the facts into `runCommitLoop`, which builds its gate context
from them (a `deps.gateContext` binding still wins for tests).

**`apps/web`** — copy: the three verbatim policy values ("Named approvals" / "Wait for me at each" /
"Run to completion") with consequences, structured-field labels, explainer text, decision-line
formats, override-grid labels. `pages.tsx`: Needs-you → `ApprovalRow` list sorted by
`needsYouOrder`; the Approvals settings section (policy radios, per-kind override grid — spend
kinds carry no control, standing-guidance list/retire/add); the once-per-user inline explainer on
the first card. `server.ts`/`data.ts`/`page-data.ts`: settings + explainers fetches; form posts
decode `ed.*` fields and the per-run override.

**Db** — migration `0032_approval_surface.sql`: `"user".dismissed_explainers text[]` (the
once-per-user explainer dismissal, same pref-column pattern as `app_theme`/`project_group_by`) +
`runs.gate_overrides jsonb` (the per-run layer, same schema as `projects.approval_overrides`).

## Stage B handoff (operator)

Deploy `api` + `web` to `dev` (`pulumi preview` first — image bumps only; no new env or bindings),
apply migration `0032` (two `IF NOT EXISTS` column adds — safe on a live table), then the $0
headless asserts on a seeded project: the Approvals section renders the three verbatim policy
values + the per-kind override grid (spend kinds absent), a PUT persists and a bad override 422s,
a standing note adds/retires (row kept, `active:false`), the explainer dismisses and stays
dismissed, a Needs-you `<details>` sheet mounts the identical `data-gate-card`. The live
Approve-plan structured-edit exercise rides P1.10's instrumented run.
